title: Livingstone
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Everyone has a soul stone with its own plan for their life, and when choices derail that plan the soul can turn impure and harm others. Sakurai, an earnest worker, and Amano, who has no soul of his own, work for 'Livingstone', finding people headed for untimely deaths to put them back on course or collect their stones. Episodic cases deal with suicide, grief and death.
life_message: A life has a meaning and course of its own, and caring for people at the edge of death is worthwhile even when fate seems fixed.
